page.title: Committees
page.subtitle: Manage committee members and attendance rotation
page.selectPrompt: Select a committee to manage its members

help.attendance: Controls which meetings this member is included in when a committee snapshot is taken. Odd = meetings 1, 3, 5, ...; Even = meetings 2, 4, 6, ...
help.majority: Evaluated against the full committee, not only the votes cast.
help.votingWaitForAll: Every member must vote before the result is decided.
help.votingQuorum: Resolves as soon as quorum and the approval rule are met; remaining members' tasks are closed.
help.committeeActive: Inactive committees are not offered for new approvals.
help.majorityFixedCount: An absolute number of approvals, regardless of how many members the committee has.
help.majorityValue: Must be between 1 and the {{max}} active member(s).

validation.majorityValueRequired: Enter the number of approvals required
validation.majorityValueExceedsMembers: Cannot exceed the {{max}} active member(s) — the round could never resolve
validation.roleRetired: This role is retired — choose one of the current roles

conditions.title: Approval Conditions ({{count}} active)
conditions.empty: No conditions — a round passes on quorum and the approval rule alone.

help.role: Evaluated against the roles of members who voted. A role no active member holds would block every round, so it is rejected.
help.snapshot: Conditions are captured when an approval round starts, so changes apply to new rounds only — approvals already in progress keep the rules they began with.

validation.roleRequired: Select a role that casts a vote
